permit_summary.note: 1 nominal $1 street-space or sidewalk permit is omitted from the timeline.

hook: A speculative house of 1937 by Konrad W. Richter, refaced in Permastone in 1957.

building.completed_conflict: The survey dates the house to October 1937 and the assessor's roll to 1938.

historic_survey.finding: Appears ineligible for the National Register and the California Register under every criterion — built as rental housing, unconnected to the boat-building community, and of low integrity

historical_record.description: Permastone siding was applied to the front, which the survey describes as radically changing the building's appearance. Two years later the property passed to the San Francisco Mountain Springs Water Company, which used it as a caretaker's residence for its plant at the old Albion Brewery next door.
A frame addition holding a living room, a kitchenette and a garage was permitted, enlarging the house significantly.
